# KPI Definition Worksheet & Requirements Log

For each KPI candidate, capture:

- KPI name and category
- business question answered
- numerator and denominator logic
- filters and exclusions
- refresh frequency
- source systems/tables
- owner and steward
- target/warning/alert thresholds

</div>

<div id="implementation-readiness" class="section level2">

## Implementation Readiness

Use data availability and build complexity to classify priority:

- **P1:** high value, feasible now
- **P2:** important but dependent on cleanup/integration
- **P3:** backlog/exploratory

</div>

<div id="requirement-to-build-traceability" class="section level2">

## Requirement-to-Build Traceability

Maintain traceability from stakeholder interview notes to:

1.  KPI registry entry
2.  BigQuery view/table specification
3.  dashboard tile/report element
4.  acceptance test

</div>
